answer_short: de, en, fr, ru, sv, es, and fi
answer_rationale: The evaluation includes both multilingual models trained on random groupings of two to three languages and monolingual models for each language. Text 3 mentions random groupings of languages, and Text 4 specifies training 50 monolingual models for each language in Track 2. Text 5 explicitly lists the seven languages evaluated: de, en, fr, ru, sv, es, and fi.
